text: The panel is still deciding who to meet. Please send a clear scan of your Aadhaar today so we can reserve your place in the shortlist.
expected_reason: Government ID requested before an interview and tied to shortlist access.

text: Your portfolio looks promising. Our coordinator needs your PAN image to open the candidate file before the technical round can be arranged.
expected_reason: PAN collection is made a prerequisite to scheduling an interview.

text: For the first screening, attach a passport photo page and your date of birth to the reply. The vacancy details will follow once your profile is registered.
expected_reason: Passport image and personal details are demanded before the role is explained.

text: We have not booked the conversation yet, but compliance requires a driver's licence number and front-and-back image to move your application forward.
expected_reason: Identity document number and images are requested at a premature hiring stage.

text: To prepare a provisional badge, enter your national ID number on this candidate form before speaking with the hiring manager.
expected_reason: National ID number is requested before any interview or established onboarding.

text: A seat opened in the graduate cohort. Send your Aadhaar copy by 6 pm or the offer packet will be reassigned to the next applicant.
expected_reason: Identity request is paired with a coercive deadline and threatened loss of offer.

text: The director has approved you directly. Keep this between us until Monday and message your PAN scan to my private number so HR does not slow the process.
expected_reason: PAN collection is combined with secrecy and avoidance of official HR.

text: Your background check is almost complete; upload the passport page now. If the upload portal is inconvenient, reply with a photo and we will enter it for you.
expected_reason: Sensitive passport page is requested through an unsafe fallback channel.

text: The hiring list is confidential. Send your tax identification number here and please do not call the company switchboard while approvals are pending.
expected_reason: Tax ID request is paired with blocked independent verification.

text: We can hold the placement through tonight only. A picture of your government ID is needed to keep your name active in the system.
expected_reason: Identity document is used as leverage to manufacture urgency.

text: The candidate portal sent a login code to your phone. Read the six digits back so I can connect your assessment to the correct application.
expected_reason: One-time login code is requested under a plausible administrative pretext.

text: I am reconciling the interview calendar. Please send the password you created for the careers page and I will check whether your application is complete.
expected_reason: Recruiter asks for the applicant's account password.

text: A secure sign-in prompt may arrive while we verify your profile. Forward the verification code as soon as it appears; it expires quickly.
expected_reason: A time-sensitive verification code is solicited.

text: To release the video interview room, reply with the number from your authenticator app. It only confirms that you are the candidate.
expected_reason: Authenticator code is solicited to gain access to an account.

text: The recruiter dashboard is locked after a system update. Share your account recovery code and I will restore your interview slot.
expected_reason: Recovery code request could enable account takeover.

text: Payroll setup starts before the written agreement in this program. Send your bank account details and PAN card to the onboarding contact on Signal.
expected_reason: Early financial and identity information harvesting through a private messaging channel.

text: The stipend vendor needs your account number and a scan of your tax card before the final interview; otherwise it cannot calculate your package.
expected_reason: Bank details and tax ID are requested before selection is complete.

text: We selected you from the application list. Email a void cheque, national ID image, and your full birth date to this personal mailbox for verification.
expected_reason: Multiple identity and financial documents are requested through an unverified mailbox.

text: For a remote internship, upload an ID document and debit card information so the finance desk can activate your monthly allowance.
expected_reason: Identity and payment-card details are not needed to activate recruitment or a stipend.

text: The background partner cannot proceed without your passport number and bank routing details. Send them directly to me rather than using the company portal.
expected_reason: Sensitive identity and banking data are redirected away from an official system.

text: The CEO personally chose you, so there will be no usual interview. Text your Aadhaar number to this account and do not ask the careers team about the exception.
expected_reason: Unusual selection claim plus ID harvesting and blocked verification.

text: Your assessment was excellent. To keep the appointment letter active, upload both sides of your PAN card before the countdown on the form reaches zero.
expected_reason: PAN scan is paired with artificial countdown pressure.

text: The applicant profile needs a one-time bank confirmation. Tell me the OTP from your banking app and I will mark your payroll details as verified.
expected_reason: Bank OTP request can authorize account access or transactions.

text: We are using an outside verifier for a confidential search. Send your licence number and a selfie with the card; please keep the search off your public application record.
expected_reason: Identity document and selfie request is concealed from official records.

text: Before we issue your contract, provide your account login name, password, and a recent statement so finance can confirm you are eligible for the role.
expected_reason: Credentials and bank statement are requested as a condition of employment.

text: The position includes a required readiness module. Purchase the access voucher from our named training partner, then send the receipt to receive your start instructions.
expected_reason: Applicant must pay a third party to unlock the job.

text: We ship laptops only after candidates buy the approved security suite from our supplier. Finance will reimburse it after your first month.
expected_reason: Upfront purchase from a named supplier is promised as reimbursement.

text: Your desk is reserved once the refundable equipment bond clears. The amount returns with your first stipend, so there is no net cost to you.
expected_reason: Refundable framing does not change the demand for an upfront deposit.

text: The internship is paid, though a short certification fee must be settled before the mentor can release the project brief.
expected_reason: Fee is imposed as a gate to a promised paid placement.

text: An external credentialing office handles our fast-track intake. Pay its candidate processing invoice directly; the hiring team cannot reserve your slot until it is marked paid.
expected_reason: Third-party processing charge is tied to access to hiring.

text: There is no recruitment charge. The only required remittance is a document-stamping cost, which the selected candidate covers before the offer is countersigned.
expected_reason: Fee is relabeled as a document cost but remains a hiring prerequisite.

text: To receive the remote workstation, transfer the shipping insurance to the courier account listed in the onboarding note; payroll adds it back later.
expected_reason: Candidate is asked to advance shipping money to an unverified account.

text: The cohort coordinator collects a refundable seat hold from each finalist. We release it after orientation attendance is recorded.
expected_reason: A seat-hold payment is demanded before the candidate starts.

text: Your interview is complete. A mandatory two-day bootcamp fee is due tonight before the company can activate your internship agreement.
expected_reason: Training fee is demanded under urgency after a claimed selection.

text: The payroll desk cannot open your file until the verification agency receives its small clearance payment. I can forward the QR code if you are ready.
expected_reason: A purported payroll verification fee is demanded to continue onboarding.

text: No fee is charged for applying. After selection, candidates pay for a stamped appointment letter and the amount is not refundable if they withdraw.
expected_reason: The offer letter itself is sold to the candidate.

text: Our supplier is running low on monitors. Order the designated model today and we will add the cost to your first paycheck after you join.
expected_reason: Candidate must buy equipment from a designated vendor for a reimbursement promise.

text: The security amount is held by our placement desk, not the employer. It comes back once you finish the first week, provided you pay before close of business.
expected_reason: Upfront deposit paid to a placement desk with a conditional refund.

text: Candidates who lack our proprietary course badge must pay the trainer directly. The badge is needed before your application can be marked successful.
expected_reason: Paid credential is presented as a condition to qualify for the job.

text: A background partner requires a refundable screening remittance from every remote hire. Use the account details in my next message so we can issue your contract.
expected_reason: Candidate is told to transfer money to an intermediary to receive a contract.

text: The company has waived the application fee, but an onboarding activation charge is still collected from the incoming intern before the first day.
expected_reason: The fee is renamed as activation but is still charged to a job seeker.

text: For asset tracking, buy a prepaid device card and give me its redemption code; our accounts team will reimburse the value with your joining bonus.
expected_reason: Gift-card purchase and code transfer enable immediate theft.

text: We can reserve the accommodation near the office if you send a refundable booking deposit to the recruiter today. Housing is mandatory for the placement.
expected_reason: Personal transfer to a recruiter is made a condition of the role.

text: A courier has your employment kit but needs a customs release payment from the recipient. Settle it through this payment link and send the confirmation to HR.
expected_reason: A fabricated courier charge is used to extract payment.

text: The interview panel has approved you. Please cover the notary and file-opening expenses now; finance will reconcile them after your first payslip.
expected_reason: Miscellaneous administrative costs are charged upfront with a reimbursement promise.

text: We partner with a licensed exam center. Pay for the assessment token before the final round; the interviewer can only see results from paid attempts.
expected_reason: Candidate is charged for access to a required assessment.

text: Our finance rules require new hires to purchase a digital signature certificate from the coordinator. It is the last step before your offer can be released.
expected_reason: A paid certificate is used to gate offer release.

text: The internship has no tuition. A refundable lab-access deposit is due to the supervisor before you can receive the campus entry pass.
expected_reason: A deposit to a supposed supervisor is required for workplace access.

text: The agency that sourced your profile charges a success administration amount after selection. Pay its invoice first; the employer will not process your contract otherwise.
expected_reason: Recruiter or sourcing agency charges a success fee to the candidate.

text: You do not need to pay to interview. If selected, however, the compliance certificate and courier package are billed together before joining.
expected_reason: Multiple relabeled charges remain required before joining.

text: Applications close at 5 pm Friday in the careers portal. If you need more time, the next graduate intake opens in September.
expected_reason: A concrete published application deadline without pressure for money or sensitive data.

text: The panel can meet Tuesday at 10 or Wednesday at 2. Please choose one by tomorrow so the coordinator can hold a room.
expected_reason: A short scheduling deadline has a routine operational reason.

text: Could you resend the resume as a PDF? The attachment in your application did not open, and a portfolio link is optional.
expected_reason: A routine resume request asks for no identity or financial information.

text: Your signed agreement is complete. Upload your identity document through the employee onboarding portal linked from the careers site you used to apply.
expected_reason: Identity collection occurs after signing through an independently reachable official portal.

text: Payroll setup begins after your start date is confirmed. The employee portal will request account details directly; recruiting will not ask you to send them by email.
expected_reason: Bank details are limited to normal post-offer payroll through an employee system.

text: The hiring manager is travelling, so we need to move your call to Monday. Please confirm the new calendar invitation when convenient.
expected_reason: An interview change is ordinary and not tied to sensitive requests.

text: The posting says applications submitted after 11:59 pm are not considered. You can review the role and submit materials through the company careers page.
expected_reason: A posted closing time is transparent and points to an official channel.

text: For your protection, our recruiting staff will never ask for a password, a login code, or an application payment. Report anyone who does.
expected_reason: The message warns against credential and fee requests rather than making them.

text: Please bring a printed copy of your CV to the campus interview. We already have the version you submitted, so this is only for the panel's notes.
expected_reason: A resume copy for an interview is low-risk and not an identity-document request.

text: After you accept the written offer, our HR platform will ask for tax and payroll forms. You may verify the platform from the employer's public site first.
expected_reason: Sensitive onboarding information follows offer acceptance and includes independent verification advice.

text: The assessment link expires at 8 pm because the interview platform closes the session then. It contains no request for payment or account credentials.
expected_reason: A time-limited link has a stated operational explanation and requests no secrets.

text: We are interviewing shortlisted applicants this week. Let us know by Wednesday if you want one of the remaining times; declining will not affect future applications.
expected_reason: Availability deadline is related to interview capacity and is not coercive.

text: Your background check starts only after written consent. The vendor will email you from the address listed on our official careers page, and there is no candidate fee.
expected_reason: Post-selection check is consent-based and explicitly free.

text: The design lead would like a link to two public work samples before the portfolio discussion. Please remove client-confidential material.
expected_reason: A public portfolio request is normal and includes sensible privacy guidance.

text: Could you confirm the interview time from the calendar invite? The room booking expires at noon, so we will release it if we do not hear back.
expected_reason: Routine room booking explains a deadline without coercion.

text: We do not collect Aadhaar or PAN during interviews. If hired, document requests will appear after contract acceptance inside the employee portal.
expected_reason: The message explicitly distinguishes interviewing from secure post-offer onboarding.

text: The internship listing will be removed when the application window closes next week. We cannot extend it individually, but you may apply to a later cohort.
expected_reason: A firm deadline is described neutrally and without threats.

text: The recruiting team has your resume. If you want, add a short note about the group project you mentioned; no other paperwork is needed for this call.
expected_reason: Optional job-relevant context is requested

text: A tax form is required before the first payroll run. The portal is reachable from the employee sign-in page on our website, not from a message attachment.
expected_reason: A stage-appropriate tax form uses the official employee route.

text: The video interview starts promptly at 3 because the panel has another candidate after you. Please join a few minutes early if possible.
expected_reason: A schedule constraint is ordinary and carries no threat or sensitive request.

text: If you receive an unexpected fee request, do not pay it. Contact our recruiting office through the company directory and include the vacancy reference.
expected_reason: Anti-fraud advice directs candidates to independently sourced contact information.

text: Your application lists two different graduation dates. Could you clarify which one is correct before the hiring panel reviews your CV?
expected_reason: Clarification of application information is relevant and not identity harvesting.

text: We plan to finish first-round interviews by the end of the month. This is an estimate, and you do not need to respond unless you want to withdraw.
expected_reason: A process timeline is not artificial urgency.

text: The offer includes a secure payroll enrollment step after your signed contract. You can call the HR number on the public website if you want confirmation first.
expected_reason: Post-offer payroll is routed through a secure step and verifiable contact.

text: Please check in at the reception desk with the visitor pass issued by campus security. The pass does not require a document scan or payment.
expected_reason: An in-person logistics instruction contains an explicit boundary against sensitive requests.

text: The team reviewed your profile this morning and would like to discuss a likely placement. We have not arranged interviews yet; can you confirm interest today?
expected_reason: Selection appears unusually fast and asks for same-day confirmation without a sensitive request.

text: I am coordinating a confidential search and can share the employer name after a short chat on my personal messaging account. No documents are needed right now.
expected_reason: Personal channel and withheld employer details warrant verification
column7: though no direct theft request appears.

text: The client wants to see identification before they decide whom to interview. Would you be comfortable discussing why they need it and how it will be stored?
expected_reason: An early ID request is concerning but phrased as a question with room to verify.

text: There may be a certification expense for this role. I am checking whether the company or the candidate covers it and will send the written policy later.
expected_reason: Unclear cost language needs confirmation; no payment is demanded yet.

text: The shortlist closes tonight, according to the coordinator. They only need to know whether you are still interested, but the public job page shows no closing date.
expected_reason: Deadline conflicts with public listing and needs independent confirmation.

text: A recruiter says the hiring manager has approved your profile without an interview and will explain the position after you accept a call tomorrow.
expected_reason: Premature approval claim and missing role detail deserve verification.

text: Please complete this candidate information form before the screening. It asks for your address and birth date but does not appear to request an ID image or payment.
expected_reason: Personal details are requested early through an unverified form.

text: The coordinator says finance needs bank details to estimate the stipend before the contract is ready. They have not shared the employee portal yet.
expected_reason: Bank details before a signed contract and official portal are stage-inappropriate.

text: Your interview confirmation is in a shortened link sent by a recruiter whose company email domain differs by one character from the public careers site.
expected_reason: A shortened link plus a domain mismatch merits verification before clicking.

text: The recruiter says the vacancy is not public yet because the team is reorganizing. They offered to send the job description after an introductory call.
expected_reason: Unpublished role and deferred details are uncertain but lack direct theft indicators.

text: The onboarding note mentions an optional course, then says candidates who take it may be considered for the next interview group. No fee amount or payment route is given.
expected_reason: Course language may imply pay-to-advance but lacks an explicit demand; verify policy.

text: After a verbal offer, the contact asks whether you can share a PAN image over email while the written contract is being prepared.
expected_reason: Identity collection after only a verbal offer and through email needs verification.

text: The calendar invitation came from a free email account. The sender says they are an external recruiter and provided a vacancy code but no company directory listing.
expected_reason: A free email and absent official listing are concerning

text: The offer summary says a small administration cost may apply to selected interns, but the recruiter has not said whether it is payable by candidates.
expected_reason: Potential candidate fee needs written clarification before proceeding.

text: The hiring contact asks for a decision by lunchtime because another finalist is waiting. They have not asked for money, documents, or account access.
expected_reason: Time pressure may be legitimate or coercive; confirm independently and take time.

text: The PDF names one subsidiary while the recruiter message names the parent company. The role title matches, but the reporting team is not specified.
expected_reason: Employer naming difference may be benign but requires clarification.

text: A recruiter asks you to install a meeting app from a file attachment because the usual calendar service is unavailable. They have not explained the software publisher.
expected_reason: Unverified software installation request introduces a device risk and needs checking.

text: The role description lists a paid induction week, while a follow-up says the induction schedule will be shared after a candidate orientation session. No explicit fee has been stated.
expected_reason: Inconsistent wording around induction costs should be resolved before acceptance.

text: The recruiter says a background vendor needs an identity check before the final interview and offers to provide the vendor's name if asked.
expected_reason: Early ID verification should be confirmed with the employer and vendor first.

text: Please avoid contacting the hiring manager until I finish arranging the panel. The sender says they are trying to prevent duplicate scheduling rather than hide the vacancy.
expected_reason: Request to avoid direct contact has a stated reason but blocks verification temporarily.

text: The program brochure describes a refundable lab deposit, but the recruiter says they are unsure whether interns pay it and will ask operations.
expected_reason: A possible deposit remains unresolved and should be confirmed in writing.

text: The candidate portal returned an error. The recruiter asked you to try again later and offered to check your status if you send the application reference, not your password.
expected_reason: A portal issue and request for an application reference are worth checking but no credential is requested.

text: The message asks you to review a role using a form hosted outside the employer's domain. The form requests a resume and availability but no identity documents.
expected_reason: Off-domain form for basic application data merits verifying its owner.

text: A contact says you are the preferred candidate after one short call and asks you to keep the news quiet until the offer is approved.
expected_reason: Fast selection and secrecy are suspicious contextual signals without a direct demand.

text: An email says the first month includes a training kit, but the attachment does not clarify whether it is supplied by the employer or purchased by the intern.
expected_reason: Unclear training-kit cost requires clarification before taking action.
